Container.Name: vBoxStock
Container.Overview: Self-contained vSeeBox inventory and sales tracker with an embedded SQLite database.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Recommended vBoxStock host port; maps to container port 3000

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and durable application data

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Host user ID used to own and write application data. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Host group ID used to own and write application data. Unraid default is 100 (users).
